works.title: Book on Masculinity and Chivalry
works.description: A book exploring positive masculine identity and emotional resilience, developing terminology that moves beyond toxic phrases like 'man up.' The work centers on alternative language emphasizing emotional strength, growth through adversity, and courageous healing without emotional suppression—including concepts like Emotional Fortitude, Healing Strength, and Post-Traumatic Growth.
works.quote: Is there a term for men finding emotional strength after an emotional loss that doesn't invoke suppressing emotion?
